name: subfinder
summary: Modular subdomain discovery tool that can discover massive amounts of valid subdomains for any target.
highlights: -list — file containing list of domains for subdomain discovery
-recursive — use only sources that can handle subdomains recursively rather than both recursive and non
-rate-limit — maximum number of http requests to send per second (global)
-rate-limits — maximum number of http requests to send per second for providers in key=value format (-rls
-t — number of concurrent goroutines for resolving (-active only) (default 10)

flags.name: -list
flags.description: file containing list of domains for subdomain discovery

flags.name: -recursive
flags.description: use only sources that can handle subdomains recursively rather than both recursive and non-recursive sources

flags.name: -all
flags.description: use all sources for enumeration (slow)

flags.name: -rate-limit
flags.description: maximum number of http requests to send per second (global)

flags.name: -rate-limits
flags.description: maximum number of http requests to send per second for providers in key=value format (-rls hackertarget=10/m) (default ["github=30/m", "fullhunt=60/m", "pugrecon=10/s", "robtex=18446744073709551615/ms", "securitytrails=1/s", "shodan=1/s", "virustotal=4/m", "hackertarget=2/s", "waybackarchive=15/m", "whoisxmlapi=50/s", "securitytrails=2/s", "sitedossier=8/m", "netlas=1/s", "github=83/m", "hudsonrock=5/s", "urlscan=1/s"])

flags.name: -t
flags.description: number of concurrent goroutines for resolving (-active only) (default 10)

flags.name: -update
flags.description: update subfinder to latest version

flags.name: -disable-update-check
flags.description: disable automatic subfinder update check

flags.name: -output
flags.description: file to write output to

flags.name: -json
flags.description: write output in JSONL(ines) format

flags.name: -output-dir
flags.description: directory to write output (-dL only)

flags.name: -collect-sources
flags.description: include all sources in the output (-json only)

flags.name: -oI
flags.description: include host IP in output (-active only)

flags.name: -config
flags.description: flag config file (default "/root/.config/subfinder/config.yaml")

flags.name: -provider-config
flags.description: provider config file (default "/root/.config/subfinder/provider-config.yaml")

flags.name: -rlist
flags.description: file containing list of resolvers to use

flags.name: -active
flags.description: display active subdomains only

flags.name: -proxy
flags.description: http proxy to use with subfinder

flags.name: -exclude-ip
flags.description: exclude IPs from the list of domains

flags.name: -max-results
flags.description: limit the number of results per source (0 = unlimited; honored by paginating sources)

flags.name: -silent
flags.description: show only subdomains in output

flags.name: -version
flags.description: show version of subfinder

flags.name: -v
flags.description: show verbose output

flags.name: -no-color
flags.description: disable color in output

flags.name: -list-sources
flags.description: list all available sources (-oJ for JSON)

flags.name: -stats
flags.description: report source statistics

flags.name: -timeout
flags.description: seconds to wait before timing out (default 30)

flags.name: -max-time
flags.description: minutes to wait for enumeration results (default 10)

flags.name: -response-size-read
flags.description: max response body size to read in bytes from passive sources (0 = unlimited)

examples.explanation: Find subdomains for a specific domain
Use a given comma-separated list of [r]esolvers
